# ArkData FAQs

#### How do I view detailed SQL execution error logs of an RDB store?

Call [on('sqliteErrorOccurred')](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/harmonyos-references/arkts-apis-data-relationalstore-rdbstore#onsqliteerroroccurred20) to obtain the error logs that occur during SQL execution.

#### How do I view SQL statements generated by an RDB store?

Call [relationalStore.getInsertSqlInfo](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/harmonyos-references/arkts-apis-data-relationalstore-f#relationalstoregetinsertsqlinfo20) to obtain the SQL statement used to insert data.

Call [relationalStore.getUpdateSqlInfo](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/harmonyos-references/arkts-apis-data-relationalstore-f#relationalstoregetupdatesqlinfo20) to obtain the SQL statement used to update data.

Call [relationalStore.getDeleteSqlInfo](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/harmonyos-references/arkts-apis-data-relationalstore-f#relationalstoregetdeletesqlinfo20) to obtain the SQL statement used to delete data.

Call [relationalStore.getQuerySqlInfo](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/en/doc/harmonyos-references/arkts-apis-data-relationalstore-f#relationalstoregetquerysqlinfo20) to obtain the SQL statement used to query data.
